rule: One-shot, state-triggered teaching. A state is entered (stranded, dead, disabled, first panel opened); its help flag is checked; if unset the popup opens and the flag is set (source/Panel.cpp 535-543), so it never repeats. The first danger is staged so the player wins by escape or by protecting an NPC, not by a damage race (convoy escort with an NPC-survival win; an evade mission whose enemy outclasses the player's shields). A bad purchase is a conversation with a named fix, not a failure state. A pre-launch flight check blocks launch and names the one missing part (source/PlanetPanel.cpp 410; data/_ui/flight checks.txt). Debt is shown on the first screen as a daily payment; a missed payment is reported (source/Account.cpp 220-222).

look_test: Three-beat prototype on the existing Pit, no release rows, no lock. Beat 1: first screen with a debt line and one engage button. Beat 2: first knockdown shows a once-only help line (25 words max). Beat 3: convoy-escort variant of the first fight with a visible keep-the-NPC-alive objective beside the normal ring fight. Dom plays each once and says whether he knows what to do within 10 seconds and which first fight feels like the first 30 minutes; pass if he can name the next goal after the escort run.
